title: Sum of Digits
description: Read a nonnegative integer and print the sum of its decimal digits.

title: Star Staircase
description: Print n rows of stars. Row i contains exactly i stars, with no leading or trailing spaces.
constraints: One row per line. A final newline is optional.

title: Hollow Square
description: Print an n × n square. Use stars on the border and ASCII spaces in the interior.
constraints: Each line has exactly n characters. A final newline is optional.

title: Pair Indices
description: Read n and a target, then n integers. Print the two zero-based indices whose values sum to the target, in ascending order.
constraints: Values and target are between −10⁹ and 10⁹.

starters.code:
n, target = map(int, input().split())
values = list(map(int, input().split()))

title: First Occurrence
description: Read n and a target, then n integers sorted in nondecreasing order. Print the first zero-based index of the target or −1.
constraints: Values and target are between −10⁹ and 10⁹.

starters.code:
n, target = map(int, input().split())
values = list(map(int, input().split()))

title: Balanced Delimiters
description: Read a line of brackets. Print YES if every bracket is paired and correctly nested, otherwise NO.

title: City Totals
description: Write a query returning city and total_sales from sales grouped by city, ordered by city ascending.

title: Department Pay Rank
description: Return department, employee_id and pay_rank. Equal salaries share a rank with no gaps within each department. Sort by department, pay_rank and employee_id.
constraints: Employee IDs are unique. All fields are non-null.

examples.input:
employees(department text, employee_id integer, salary integer)
(A, 1, 80), (A, 2, 80), (A, 3, 60)
examples.output:
department | employee_id | pay_rank
A | 1 | 1
A | 2 | 1
A | 3 | 2

title: Filter Students
description: Write a single expression that returns rows of df where Age is greater than 15. Preserve the original columns and index.
constraints: df is a Pandas DataFrame with non-null integer ages.

title: Monthly Orders
description: Implement monthly_orders(df). Return a DataFrame with columns month (YYYY-MM) and order_count, sorted by month, with a fresh integer index.
constraints: placed_at contains valid ISO calendar dates.

title: Row Centering
description: Write a NumPy expression that subtracts each row’s mean from every entry in that row without changing the array shape.
constraints: x is a nonempty two-dimensional NumPy array.

title: Sample Variance
description: Compute the sample variance using a denominator of n − 1. Enter a single number.

title: Independent Events
description: For independent events A and B, which formula gives P(A ∩ B)?

title: Salary Outliers with IQR
description: Implement outliers(df) to return the original rows whose salary is strictly outside Q1 − 1.5 × IQR and Q3 + 1.5 × IQR.

title: Spark Region Totals
description: Implement region_totals(df) to return region and total for each region, sorted alphabetically by region.
constraints: Amounts are non-null integers. Regions are non-null strings.

title: MapReduce Word Count
description: Implement map_line(line) to yield (word, 1) pairs and reduce_word(word, counts) to return (word, total). Split on whitespace and normalize to lowercase.
constraints: The example shows grouped output sorted by word.

title: Linear Prediction
description: Implement predict(x, weights, bias) to return one prediction per row using the dot product plus bias.
constraints: x and weights are compatible NumPy arrays.

title: Binary F1 Score
description: Implement f1_score(actual, predicted) for positive class 1. Return zero when the denominator is zero.
constraints: Inputs have equal length and contain only 0 or 1.

title: ReLU Layer
description: Implement relu(x) using PyTorch operations that preserve the input shape, dtype and gradient tracking.
constraints: x is a floating-point PyTorch tensor.
